slug: 朝廷鹰犬没挨过六扇门的刀
content_zh:
重生与自知之明。
李家，书房。
“你来了。”李君肃看着面前跟自己模样八分相似的男人叹了口气说着。
“哥哥，对不起，我为什麽帮不上”男人低下头，强忍着眼泪。
“没事，是我太年轻了。好了，出去吧，以後李家就交给你了。”李君肃说罢，看着奢华的书房，转而垂眸看着眼前的抽屉。
男人一步三回头的看着书桌后英俊的男子，他好像永远都是一副冷冷淡淡的样子。
可男人知道，自家哥哥是最在乎家人的。
男人走後，李君肃拉开抽屉，黑色左轮上的金色纹路摄人心魄。
他从接手李家开始，到成为魔都说一不二的存在，何等意气风发。
但过於狂傲迎来的或许不是说一不二，更多的是群起而攻之。
现在，他们的报复来了。
他可以接下，但是李家不可以。
“家族的一切都是为了存续。”父亲的话语犹在耳畔。
李君肃给李家安排好了所有退路，除了他自己的。
只有他死了，他们的梦魇才会消散，才会权衡利弊，才会忌惮自己给李家留下的後手。
至於後手，李君肃想了想那些在官场浮沉了几十年的老狐狸，笑了笑。
“爸，我可比你厉害多了。”李君肃转动左轮，笑眯眯的想着。
哪怕情况糟糕到此，李家也还富足有馀，还有资本卷土重来。
至於後面就要看他们自己了。
死亡对他来说好似微不足道，事实也确实如此。

“如果有来世，结仇了记得灭人满门。”李君肃临死前，一如当初接下李家家主之位时，一样的狂傲。
砰，扳机扣动，血液飞出，李君肃安详的躺在椅子上。
就像，他只是睡着了一样。
“哥！”
“死了？”
“嗯。”
“人死债消，让那些鬣狗滚回去。”
“知道了。”
“可惜了，好梦。”
李君肃曾经思考过死亡，闭上眼睛，什麽也不想。
一片黑暗，没有思考，那就是死亡。
但，现在是什麽情况？
“温暖？”李君肃只有一个模糊的念头。
“以後我就是二夫人了？！”女子惊喜的声音传来。
“二夫人？大清那废物朝代都亡了多久了。”李君肃不屑的想着，而後翻了个身。
“哎哟！”
“夫人您小心点，别动了胎气。”
“我知道了，这孩子啊真是有活力。”
“夫人，我们是否需要”嬷嬷比划了个抹脖子的手势。
“不需要。”艳丽的美艳妇人淡淡开口。

“出来了！出来了！是个小少爷！”
“我这是？”李君肃听着嘈杂的声音，迷迷糊糊的睁开眼。
“睁眼了！小少爷可真健康！”接生婆不管三七二十一，先夸就对了。
吉利话说的越好，红包越大。
“这里是？”李君肃看着古色古香的房间，迷迷糊糊的又闭上了眼。
content_en:
Rebirth and self-knowledge.
Li family, study room.
"You're here." Li Junsu sighed as he looked at the man in front of him who looked very similar to himself.
"Brother, I'm sorry, why can't I help?" The man lowered his head and held back tears.
"It's okay, it's just that I'm too young. Okay, go out, and the Li family will be left to you from now on." After Li Junsu said that, he looked at the luxurious study and then lowered his eyes at the drawers in front of him.
The man turned back three times to look at the handsome man behind the desk. He seemed to always have a cold and indifferent look.
But the man knows that his brother cares about his family the most.
After the man left, Li Junsu opened the drawer, and the golden patterns on the black revolver were breathtaking.
How high-spirited he was from taking over the Li family to becoming one of the most influential people in the city.
But being overly arrogant may not only lead to one-sided attacks, but more of a group attack.
Now, their revenge has come.
He can take it, but the Li family can't.
"Everything about the family is for survival." My father's words are still in my ears.
Li Junsu arranged all escape routes for the Li family, except his own.
Only when he dies will their nightmares dissipate, will they be able to weigh the pros and cons, and will they be wary of the backhand they have left for the Li family.
As for the backup plan, Li Junsu thought about those old foxes who had been floating in the officialdom for decades and smiled.
"Dad, I'm much better than you." Li Junsu turned the revolver and thought with a smile.
Even if the situation is as bad as this, the Li family is still rich and has the capital to make a comeback.
As for what happens next, it's up to them.
Death seemed trivial to him, and it was.
"If there is an afterlife, remember to kill all the people in the family if you make enemies." Before Li Junsu died, he was as arrogant as when he took over the position of head of the Li family.
Bang, the trigger was pulled, blood flew out, and Li Junsu lay peacefully on the chair.
Like, he just fell asleep.
"Brother!"
"Dead?"
"Yeah."
"The debt will be wiped out after death. Let those hyenas go back."
"Got it."
"What a shame, sweet dream."
Li Junsu once thought about death, closed his eyes and thought about nothing.
Darkness, without thinking, is death.
But, what is the situation now?
"Warmth?" Li Junsu only had a vague thought.
"I will be the second wife from now on?!" came the woman's surprised voice.
"Second Madam? How long has it been since the Qing Dynasty died?" Li Junsu thought disdainfully, and then turned over.
"Ouch!"
"Ma'am, please be careful, don't get pregnant."
"I know, this kid is really energetic."
"Madam, do we need it?" Mammy made a gesture of wiping her neck.
"No need." The gorgeous woman said calmly.
"It's out! It's out! It's a young master!"
"Who am I?" Li Junsu opened his eyes drowsily as he listened to the noisy voice.
"Open your eyes! The young master is so healthy!" The midwife didn't care about other things, she just praised him first.
The better Geely's words, the bigger the red envelope.
"Is this here?" Li Junsu looked at the antique room and closed his eyes again in a daze.
